messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning a minimal base-image rebuild this week to reduce attack surface and rotate signing keys. Goal: smaller rootfs, no dev packages, reproducible build, and KMS-backed signing. I want to run a staged canary and validate runtime behavior before full roll.

dan: +1. Do you have a canary rollout plan and rollback criteria? also need a clear RBAC plan for the new signing key.

maria: Canary plan proposal: 1% (build/test infra) -> 10% (internal staging) -> 50% (non-critical prod) -> 100%. Rollback if any of: failing health checks, >3% increase in 5xx, or new CVE regressions from scans. Rollout windows: 2-hour observation each step.

cj: RBAC notes: the pipeline service account will need kms.signerVerifier + permissions to read the key ring. Also add a short-lived key-holder role for on-call to rotate if urgent. We should update IAM docs and run a brief preflight: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` checks.

olivia: Audit / compliance question: do we capture cosign attestations and KMS key usage in our central audit logs? We need both for forensic trails and to satisfy the retention policy (1 year for attestation events). If not, we should wire KMS audit logs -> security-logs (Splunk) before cutover.

security-bot: image-scan: new build flagged CVE-2024-9999 in libcrypto (low) — will re-scan after rebuild.

sre-jen: Runtime hardening checklist: run containers rootless where possible, enforce seccomp + apparmor, drop CAP_NET_RAW, set read-only rootfs, and enable execve sandboxing. Also test OOM/CPU throttling under load tests.

dan: For KMS integration: are we using cloud KMS or a vault HSM? cosign supports both (`cosign sign --kms gcpkms://...` or `--key` for PKCS11). We need a compatibility matrix in the PR.

maria: Using GCP KMS for now. Example signing command for CI:
```
COSIGN_PASSWORD="" 
cosign sign --kms gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/rebuild-2026 
  gcr.io/redwood/runtime-base:20260301
```
We'll add a short Post-Build attestation step that emits SBOM + cosign predicate to the artifact registry.

cj: One more RBAC gotcha — when rotating keys, old signatures must still validate. Plan: create new key version and update cosign public pointer after we finish signing. Ensure deployers accept both sigs for a 48h transition window.

olivia: On logging: I'll schedule a small job to verify KMS admin logs show SignAs events and forward to splunk:test-index. Also confirm that image-pull audit events include attestation metadata.

sre-jen: Canary metrics to watch: container start latency, image pull failures, OOM kills, and our custom health-check probe latency. I'll add alerts for >2x baseline or >=5% error spikes.

dan: Who owns rollout? assignable tasks?

maria: I'll own build & signing PR. @cj will own IAM changes and preflight. @olivia will own audit forwarding and retention. @sre-jen will author the canary monitoring dashboard and alert rules. @dan please review rollback automation. I'll open PRs by EOD and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: base-image-rebuild-canary -> 2026-03-04T22:00Z (automated canary job). See runbook https://internal.redwood/rebuild-runbook

maria: Thanks — leaving action items in the PR. If anyone spots missing pieces call it out here. :)
